newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market steady - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn feedlot cattle market steady - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were steady on a live basis, compared to Wednesday's close, USDA said. Demand and seller interest moderate. Offerings current.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1225-1300 lbs 67.50-68.00 few to 68.75. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1100 lbs few 67.00.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Wednesdays close - Slaughter steers and heifers steady.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1175-1300 lbs 110.00 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs no sales Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs no sales.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1075-1175 lbs 109.00-110.00.
